scope: Independent resumed inspection of original images only. No art, ledger, archive or approval changes.

status_semantics.pass: Bounded visual candidate pass, not user approval, release authorization or mechanical certification.

shared_limitations: Existing static desktop/mobile endpoint captures only; no new browser run, animation clearance sampling, physical-phone test or Blender reopening.
